function.name: record_payment
function.description: Use this tool when the consumer explicitly agrees to make a payment right now during the call. Do NOT call this if the consumer is only discussing payment options, asking about their balance, or has not yet committed to paying.

amount.description: The dollar amount the consumer agreed to pay (e.g., 189.00)

method.description: How the payment is being made. Default to 'phone' for payments taken during this call.

messages.content: Let me note that payment on your account.
